title: Engineering the sialome of mammalian cells with sialic acid mimetics
author: Hornikx, Visser, et al.
materials: Goat anti-human IgG Fc, FITC conjugated
Recombinant human Siglec-3/CD33 Fc chimera protein

steps.title: Prepare SAM working stocks
steps.instruction: Dissolve each SAM powder to a final concentration of 100 mM in cell‑culture‑grade DMSO, vortex until fully dissolved, aliquot into Eppendorf tubes and store at –20 °C (stable ≥1 year, tolerates freeze‑thaw).

substeps.instruction: If desired, prepare a 1 M SAM solution in DMSO and dilute stepwise in water to reach the target concentration, noting that water solubility varies by SAM.

steps.title: Culture Jurkat cells with SAMs
steps.instruction: Seed Jurkat cells (0.2–0.4 × 10⁶ cells per well) in a 96‑well U‑bottom plate and incubate for 3 days with 0–256 µM Ac5Neu5Ac3F or Ac5SiaNPoc, adding an equal volume of DMSO as vehicle control.

steps.title: Wash cells three times
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, flick off supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 150 µL PBS‑BSA; repeat this wash three times.

steps.title: Stain membrane sialoglycans with MALII
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL PBS‑BSA containing 5 µg/mL biotinylated MALII lectin and incubate 45 min at 4 °C; then centrifuge 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, flick supernatant, and wash twice with 150 µL PBS‑BSA.

steps.title: Label alkyne sialoglycans via click chemistry
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL extracellular CuAAC solution and incubate 20 min at 37 °C; centrifuge 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, flick supernatant, and wash three times with 150 µL PBS‑BSA buffer.

steps.title: Streptavidin‑PE labeling
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL PBS‑BSA containing 1 µg/mL streptavidin‑PE conjugate and incubate 20 min at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after streptavidin labeling
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with 150 µL PBS‑BSA by centrifugation (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).

steps.title: Final cell resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 100 µL PBS‑BSA, keep at 4 °C protected from light, and gently pipette or shake immediately before flow‑cytometry to ensure a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run the samples on a CytoFlex (or equivalent) flow cytometer using the plate‑reader function; acquire fluorescence data for MALII‑PE and click‑chemistry fluorophore.

steps.title: Analyze flow cytometry results
steps.instruction: Gate live cells (FSC/SSC) in FlowJo, export MFI values to Excel, normalize MALII MFI to DMSO control (set as 100 %), plot dose‑response curves in GraphPad Prism using log‑scaled concentrations and a four‑parameter variable‑slope fit (Log(agonist) vs response) to obtain EC₅₀ values.
